method.pairOrders: AB for odd formal pairs, BA for even formal pairs; the one declared warmup is AB.
method.input: A real main-nav click opens the bag; focused native select receives ArrowDown, ArrowDown, Home. Each timing starts in the trusted DOM click/change capture listener.
method.endpoint: Second requestAnimationFrame callback after capture. This is callback latency, not measured paint completion, FPS or physical GPU performance.
method.longTasks: All observed entries that overlap the measured capture-to-second-rAF window; observation is supplementary and does not change the endpoint.
method.oracle: Every action requires the first 60 rendered IDs to equal its version selector, and all complete card DOM trees to equal its own source center() parsed by native DOMParser. Both persisted copies must remain exactly equal to the fixture string.
method.sampling: No automatic retry, outlier removal, or replacement of failed/slow samples. All formal samples and the declared warmup remain separately visible. Smoke results are separate and must not be pooled.
method.quantiles: p50 uses the middle-two mean; p95 uses nearest rank ceil(n*.95). With n=12, p95=max.
method.fixtures: Generated from this script and the recorded seed/source hashes. Full ten-thousand-item save strings are deliberately not written into report files.
